title: Cursor Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for .cursor-plugin/plugin.json — defines a single Cursor plugin's metadata, components, and configuration.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier in kebab-case (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens and periods).

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the plugin.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

minClientVersions.description: Minimum client versions required to install the plugin, keyed by client identifier.

repository.description: URL to the plugin's source code repository.

logo.description: Path to a logo image (relative to the plugin root) or an absolute URL.

commands.description: Glob pattern(s) or path(s) to command files.

agents.description: Glob pattern(s) or path(s) to agent definition files.

skills.description: Glob pattern(s) or path(s) to skill files.

rules.description: Glob pattern(s) or path(s) to rule files.

hooks.description: Path to a hooks configuration file, or an inline hooks object.

variables.description: JSON Schema for user-configured plugin variables.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configuration — a path, an inline config object, or an array of either.

cursor.description: Minimum Cursor version required to install the plugin (e.g. "3.13.0"), or "never" to hide it from Cursor entirely.

grokbot.description: Minimum Grok Bot version required to install the plugin (e.g. "0.49.0"), or "never" to hide it from Grok Bot entirely.

sand.description: Deprecated client id for Grok Bot. Same meaning as grokbot.

additionalProperties.description: Minimum version required for another client identifier, or "never" to hide the plugin from that client.

clientVersionRequirement.description: A minimum semantic version, or the literal "never" when that client must not list or install the plugin.

semver.description: Strict semantic version "X.Y.Z" with an optional prerelease suffix.
